node.label: Paul Veyne
node.date_label: Comment on écrit l’histoire (1971) · Le Pain et le Cirque (1976) · Les Grecs ont-ils cru à leurs mythes? (1983)
node.description: A historian of the ancient world who also asks how historians select and explain events. In the selected methodological extract, an event gains relevance within a chosen inquiry, but that choice does not make the relations within it arbitrary. His concept of intrigue can include several temporal rhythms and need not follow a simple chronological sequence. The map compares that position with the later narrative debate without asserting a historical transmission or treating historical narrative as licensed fiction.
